subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) He is a rebel poet and our national poet. (b) You will have heard the name of Kazi Nazrul Islam. (c) He was called Dukhu Mia for his sorrow. (d) One day this Dukhu Mia became a great poet. (e) He lost his father in his childhood. (f) As a result, his mother fell in great financial problem. (g) He spent his early life in great hardship. (h) Nazrul Islam, was born on the 20 May, 1899 in Burdwan. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
